prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity visual direction comp for a native iPhone railway departures app
Primary request: Create one production-grade, ultra-modern portrait iPhone app screen for “Last Train” built around railway signal optics and route-setting light paths. This is an in-app screen, not a marketing image.
Scene/backdrop: Full-bleed 393x852-style iPhone canvas with a clean Dynamic Island safe area at the top. No phone hardware frame, no device mockup, no surrounding environment.
Subject and information architecture: A native iOS journey screen. At the top, a compact mode switch visibly includes the exact uppercase labels “LAST TRAIN” and “FAST TRAIN”, with LAST TRAIN selected. The station block visibly reads “Upminster” with direction “EAST”. A single vertical projected route beam connects the station, direction, departures, and first service back. Show three large, highly legible departure rows: “22:58”, “23:18”, and “23:32”. Make “23:47” the sole final departure and the only red optical event, clearly associated with destination “Shoeburyness”. Also visibly show “FIRST BACK 05:12”. Include the exact helper text “Direct services only”.
Style/medium: Exceptional high-fidelity native SwiftUI interface concept; current premium iOS design language; rail context immediately clear; modern railway signal optics, illuminated route indicators, precise alignment, confident typography, accessible hierarchy. Not a literal vintage railway board.
Composition/framing: Full screen app UI, balanced safe-area spacing, huge legible times, one continuous vertical route spine/beam, departures organized as route events rather than generic cards. No bottom tab bar. Minimal chrome.
Lighting/mood: Subtle luminous signal optics on an almost-black ground, restrained depth, quiet precision, calm late-night atmosphere.
Color palette: #061018 ground, #EAF2F5 primary text, #4DE1FF optical cyan, #173141 deep route metal, #FF304C reserved only for the last train “23:47” event. Do not use red anywhere else.
Materials/textures: Optical glass and anodized midnight metal, ultra-subtle reflections and edge highlights, crisp native text, restrained dimensionality.
Text (verbatim): “LAST TRAIN”, “FAST TRAIN”, “Upminster”, “EAST”, “23:47”, “Shoeburyness”, “22:58”, “23:18”, “23:32”, “FIRST BACK 05:12”, “Direct services only”
Constraints: Every listed text string must be visibly present and spelled exactly. Preserve a clean Dynamic Island safe area. Design must look feasible to implement with native SwiftUI best practices. No durations. No +1 labels. No calendar-next-day labels. No generic glass card dashboard. No bottom tab bar.
Avoid: phone hardware frame, marketing poster composition, floating glass cards, generic fintech dashboard, vintage split-flap board, skeuomorphic train signage, gradients that reduce contrast, illegible microcopy, fake brand logos, watermark, decorative red accents, duration text, “+1”, dates, calendar labels.
